content:
**Responders Civil Engineer Underarmor** is an Underarmor in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Appalachia Under Siege* season.

Can be modified with Civil Engineer Underarmor Linings. Crafting requires having learned Plan: Civil Engineer Underarmor.

Crafting of the item can be unlocked as a reward during *Appalachia Under Siege*. 

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Cloth (6) Leather (2) Steel (2) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:****Cost:**40 | | Responders Civil Engineer Underarmor (1) | 

The item can only be crafted by the player.
